Not Leon and not an animation. Depth, stance, arm position and timing are placeholders awaiting qualified technique review.

Same pose as frame 1: the loop

Timing: 0.8 s hold, then 3 reps of 1.8 s down, 0.3 s pause, 1.4 s up, 0.3 s pause = 12.2 s loop. Ringed: hips, knees, ankles. Script checks (fixed feet, limb lengths) test the drawing, not the technique.
